review_type: Independent read-only review of root API/CSS/Docker/SSR changes; separately author of high-DPI fix requiring root review
code_review_observations: Shared CSS source URLs resolve relative to platform/packages/i18n into repository data/fonts/scripts; Vite imports them through the small web wrapper and emits hashed assets.

CSS opts only new complex-script locales into script families using :lang selectors (pa covers both Punjabi script tags); existing locales retain existing typography. Language picker options carry explicit lang attributes.

Server stylesheet rebases exact font URL prefix to same-origin /signin/assets. Font names come from pinned manifest allowlist; regex rejects slashes and unknown TTF names return404. Existing design assets retain original serving path.
SSR body/headings/room typography uses script variables with original stacks as fallback. sendPage supplies response-local lang/dir and font-src self permits served files without widening CSP.

Docker web build and production runtime copy font tree plus Noto licence to /app/data/fonts, matching import.meta-relative API source paths; runtime stages consume that tree. Native packaging adds linked HarfBuzz alongside SDL libraries.
Sign-in conditional suffix now translated before interpolation into response-local message; username interpolation stays escaped by existing pageHtml path, not treated as trusted markup.

Match outcomes use existing statusLabel mapping (lost, abandoned etc), and boolean No passes through translator. TeamCards already subscribes to locale and statistic block retains existing locale behavior.

independent_Docker_runtime_verification.scope: Actual production pageAssetRoutes imported inside built image; Fastify inject endpoint checks. No browser rendering inferred.

font_investigation.root_cause: Authored-size measurement and independently hinted high-DPI advances differ. A real Hindi line measured362 logical px but raw26px font rendered754px (377 logical), exceeding366px slot. Six observed overflow lines exactly reproduced with pinned SDL3_ttf/Noto/HarfBuzz10.1.0.
font_investigation.rejected_shortcut: No-hint or light-subpixel still has0–2px metric rounding and changes authored layout; adding slack or clipping would hide mismatch.

authored_font_fix.behavior: Scaled script drawing uses authored measured width for the full raster destination; fractional raster quantization does not reapply to normalized horizontal advance. Native anisotropic output retains min-axis correction. Vertical geometry retains existing physical raster behavior. Legacy/scriptless geometry and raw rasterizeString pixels remain unchanged.
authored_font_fix.public_geometry_API: TrueTypeFont::getStringDrawSize(text, requestedScale, outputScaleX=1, outputScaleY=1) returns logical destination extent using exactly the same geometry helper as both drawString overloads. Native axis ratios are drawable/logical; matrix defaults to isotropic axes.
